answers.evidence:
**All 17 tests pass** with race detector enabled:

| Test | What it covers |
|------|---------------|
| `TestBasicSnapshotInstall` | Single-chunk snapshot, verifies metadata, state machine, commit/lastApplied indices |
| `TestChunkedSnapshotInstall` | Out-of-order chunk delivery across 4+ chunks |
| `TestDuplicateChunks` | 3 full passes of duplicate chunk sends — verifies idempotency |
| `TestLogConflictResolution` | Snapshot at (3,1) where log entry at (3,1) matches → keeps entries after index 3 |
| `TestLogConflictNoMatch` | Snapshot at (3,3) where log has entry at (2,2) — no match → discards conflicting entries |
| `TestStaleSnapshotRejection` | Newer snapshot installed → older snapshot returns success (already ahead) |
| `TestInterruptedTransferResume` | Only 2 of 4 chunks sent → no snapshot; retransmit all 4 → snapshot installed |
| `TestSendSnapshot` | End-to-end leader → follower via `SendSnapshot` with `sendFn` |
| `TestOutOfOrderWithDuplicates` | Chaotic order: 3,1,1,0,2,0,3 — never sends final chunk → snapshot NOT installed (correct) |
| `TestMultipleLeadersSnapshot` | Two leaders simultaneously sending different snapshots |
| `TestEmptyStateMachineSnapshot` | `map[string]string{}` encoded and installed correctly |
| `TestSnapshotAtLogBoundary` | Snapshot at the exact last log entry index |
| `TestZeroChunkCount` | `ChunkCount=0` rejected with `Success=false` |
| `TestStaleLeaderTerm` | Leader term 5 < follower term 10 → rejected with term=10 |
| `TestInterleavedSnapshotsFromDifferentLeaders` | Leaders 10 and 20 interleave chunks; leader 10 completes first |
| `TestConcurrentSnapshotOperations` | 5 goroutines send snapshots concurrently — no races or deadlocks |
| `TestLogPreservationAfterSnapshot` | Entries after snapshot point preserved only if term matches |

**Benchmark**: `BenchmarkChunkedSnapshotInstall` completes in ~11.5µs per operation.

**Race detector**: Clean — no data races detected across all concurrent tests.
